title: Trade Response
description: The target team's reply to a trade-offer.json (PLAN.md §4 step 5: the target agent gets one accept/reject/counter; the offerer then gets final accept/reject on a counter). When several offers arrive in the same week, answer each in `responses`; a lone offer may still use the flat top-level form.

response.description: accept/reject the offer as-is, or counter with a new offer.

counter.description: Required when response is 'counter'; shaped like trade-offer.json ({to_team, out, in, message?}) but 'to_team' is implicitly the original offerer.

message.description: Optional in-character note attached to the response.

drop.description: Player ids you cut to make room, required when accepting an offer whose 'requires_drop' names you. Accepting without enough drops is refused at apply time.

responses.description: One entry per offer addressed to you, when more than one arrived. `from` names the offering team so each answer is unambiguous.

from.description: Slug of the team whose offer this answers.

honour.description: Conflict turns only (context has conflict: true): the `index` values of your own accepted offers you are going through with. The rest are declined in your name.
